title: Iron Boy (FCP 2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: 鐵甲小男孩的成長大冒險 (FCP 2026)

synopsis:
In rural France, Christophe tries to live up to his rigid, distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning, on the tractor, at school, at dinner. A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, he discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?


Un Certain Regard Special Jury Prize, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
在法國鄉村，少年 Christophe 總是無法站直，不論在拖拉機上、課室裡、飯桌上，都會隨時倒下。儘管如此，他還是努力想成為嚴苛父親心目中的好兒子。醫生處方他穿上鐵甲束身衣，迫使他挺直腰骨，也讓他遠離農地。他開始喜歡音樂，遇上帥氣女孩，也第一次離家冒險。鐵衣支撐的不只是身體，更是失衡的心靈與家庭關係。Christophe 能否在束縛中重獲自由，在傾側的世界找回重心? 關於成長、家庭、勇氣的動人小品，以細膩筆觸繪畫鄉村少年的脆弱與堅韌。

 

康城影展 一種關注單元評審團特別獎
